user.title: Select Votronic Bluetooth Connector
user.description: Power on the Votronic Bluetooth Connector and wait until it appears in the list.

pair.title: Pair Votronic Bluetooth Connector
pair.description: Briefly press the Key button on the Votronic Bluetooth Connector. The yellow and green LEDs then blink alternately for up to 3 minutes; confirm within that time. If they do not start blinking alternately, hold the button for 3 seconds to delete all pairings, including those with phones and tablets, then press it briefly again.

pairing_code.title: Enter pairing code
pairing_code.description: The Bluetooth Connector did not accept the default pairing code 173928, so a user pairing code is set. Enter it and confirm while the LEDs blink alternately; if they stopped, briefly press the Key button again.

error.cannot_connect: Connection or pairing failed. Make sure the Bluetooth Connector is in range and retry.
error.local_adapter_required: The connection runs through a Bluetooth proxy. This is not supported. Home Assistant must reach the Bluetooth Connector with its own Bluetooth adapter.
error.no_devices_found: No Votronic Bluetooth Connector found. Make sure Bluetooth is set up in Home Assistant and the device is in range.
error.unsupported_device: The device was found but does not expose the expected Votronic monitoring characteristics.
error.pairing_not_accepted: The Bluetooth Connector is not in pairing mode. Briefly press the Key button until the yellow and green LEDs blink alternately, then confirm within 3 minutes.
error.wrong_pairing_code: The Bluetooth Connector rejected the pairing code. Check the code and retry while the LEDs blink alternately.
error.invalid_pairing_code: Enter the six digits of the pairing code.

abort.already_configured: This Votronic device is already configured.
abort.not_supported: This Bluetooth device is not a supported Votronic device.
